title: benchmarks.py pool build writes a stratified question pool with a check per row, from the eval, held-out, off-kb, gaps and query-log sources plus phrasing variants
goal: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py pool build writes kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv (columns id, kind, domain, phrasing, source, question, checks, expected_route) with about 100 public rows: 40 sampled from lookup_eval.csv stratified by domain with a seed, their answer regex written by Sonnet from the cited fact line (the blind-question prompt of bench_retrieval.py reused), 20 rows that name lookup_heldout.csv rows by id and read their text at run time (never copied, reworded or expanded, as the held-out rule says), 15 from the off-kb list (expected_route none), 10 from _gaps.md and the verdict design misses (false good, near miss), 10 tool-answerable (counts, who cites a source id, a DECISION, a conflict), 5 SNIPPET units, and 30 phrasing variants of 10 facts (keyword-only, full sentence, lowercase or typo brand); pool build --querylog writes kb/_querylog/bench/pool.csv with 20 redacted questions from the distilled store (redact.py over each, the leak scan clean), a path kbgit.py publish strips; every row has at least one check regex; a test runs build on a fixture kb and a fixture store and checks the counts per kind, the seed's determinism, that a held-out row holds no question text, and that no query-log row reaches the public file; kb/_self/tools.md has the command's row
notes: Sources on disk: kb/public/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv (285 rows), lookup_heldout.csv (20 rows; the held-out rule in the conduct section: never copied into a tuned file, reworded or expanded, so the pool names them by id and reads the text at run time), the off-kb list bench_retrieval.py reads (106 questions), kb/public/_gaps.md, the verdict design misses in benchmarks.md (cmpivot, bitlocker typed lowercase), rag.py audit for counts and kb_source --cited for who-cites rows, _decisions.csv and _conflicts.md for a DECISION and a conflict row. The query-log file: kb/_querylog/bench/pool.csv is under the prefix kbgit.py publish strips (kg_sync.py:424), but kbgit.py:155 says the store's run files are never edited and check.py or ql_store may read the directory: confirm a bench/ subdirectory is tolerated by check.py and the ql_store readers before writing there, else choose a sidecar path they define, and record the chosen path in tools.md. Answer regexes written by Sonnet cost one call for the 40 eval rows (bench_retrieval's blind set cost 0.07 USD for 72); the phrasing variants' regexes are the base row's. Kinds tagged so the report groups by them: fact, csv_fact, multi, count, cites, decision, conflict, snippet, synthesis, offkb, false_good, near_miss, heldout, querylog, variant_keyword, variant_sentence, variant_typo. Tests in _tools/test_bench.py (created by ST-37c3f5l5; if this story lands first it creates the file). -k bench_pool collects nothing until the work adds the test.
